summary: Forcepoint next-generation firewall with built-in IPS, VPN and SD-WAN for offices, branches and data centers; Forcepoint Secure SD-WAN is sold on the same platform.
value: Known attacks and exploits are blocked at the network edge before reaching internal systems.
Remote workers and branches connect to the network through an encrypted tunnel.
Branches get multiple internet links with automatic failover without losing protection.
Branches and data centers are managed centrally, without configuring each firewall by hand.
simple: Forcepoint NGFW is a firewall with deep packet inspection, TLS 1.2/1.3 decryption, built-in IPS with anti-evasion protection, Anti-Botnet, DoS protection and gateway antivirus. VPN: IPsec and TLS for site-to-site connections (hub-and-spoke, full or partial mesh) and for remote workers (Forcepoint VPN client for Windows, Android, macOS, standard IPsec clients, TLS portal). SD-WAN: multiple ISPs, application-based routing, link quality monitoring. Appliances (from 60 Series for retail stores to 3500 Series for data centers) and virtual. Management — Forcepoint Security Management Center (SMC). A ZTNA App Connector provides access to internal applications through Forcepoint’s cloud service.
notIncluded: No URL filtering — separate URL Filtering subscription.
Sandbox (Zero-Day Sandboxing, Advanced Malware Detection) is a separate service in the cloud or on-prem.
classification: Firewall, IPS, gateway antivirus — NGFW; Anti-Botnet on the firewall itself is also within NGFW, no web filtering (URL Filtering is a separate subscription).
IPsec/TLS VPN for remote workers and between offices — VPN.

DoS/DDoS Protection on the firewall itself is within NGFW, not DDoS protection (it does not absorb traffic before it reaches the network); URL Filtering and sandbox are separate subscriptions, not counted as classes; SD-WAN, ZTNA App Connector — text only.
